body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Chief Manufacturing presented its automated flat panel and projector mounting solutions ‘CM2C40’ during CES 2008, which allows users to raise and lower a flat panel from the ceiling at the press of button.
Designed for 61-inch flat panel TVs and over or up to 86.2 kg, the CM2C40 provides up/down travel at over 2-inch per second. A cable management system makes installation clean and hassle free.
According to the company, the CM2C40 is suitable for a variety of installations, from residential to corporate boardroom, and applications where the flat panel needs to be hidden when not in use.
